name: native-icons
author: lumine-code
description: Show native OS file icons in the tree view, tabs, and archive view.

greenlist.title: Greenlist
greenlist.description: Show native icons for filenames matching one of these patterns, and leave every other file to whichever icon package would otherwise draw it. Use `*` for all files. The other forms are `*.ext`, `*ext`, `name*`, `*sub*`, and `exact`, matched case-insensitively against the file name. Entries may contain comma-space separated patterns, e.g. `*.dat, *ipy`. Patterns containing `?` or `*` in the middle are ignored with a console warning. Empty means this package draws nothing.

blacklist.title: Blacklist
blacklist.description: Never show a native icon for filenames matching one of these patterns. Same syntax and comma-space separated entries as the greenlist. The blacklist always wins. Examples: `*.min.js`, `*.bak`, `*~`.

useCustomFileTypes.title: Honour `core.customFileTypes`
useCustomFileTypes.description: When a file matches a pattern under the `core.customFileTypes` setting (e.g. `source.python: ["ipy"]`), show the icon of the grammar's primary file extension (`.py`) instead of the file's real extension. Useful for custom extensions that share a grammar.

useFullPathForExecutables.title: Use real path for embedded-icon binaries
useFullPathForExecutables.description: For `.exe`, `.lnk`, `.ico`, `.dll`, `.url`, `.scr`, `.msi` files, query the actual file's icon (each binary carries its own). Turn off to use a generic icon per extension.
